about: F01 Chasing Light shot list (FILM.md, brief.md). Output times: poster 0-0.8, diorama 0.8-2.1, m_dawn grow + dive 2.1-4.17, camper 4.17-6.2, lake 6.2-8.9, lake_close 8.9-11.4, falls 11.4-16.4, cliff 16.4-19.4, tailgate 19.4-22.0, sky 22.0-23.2, sofa 23.2-24.4, mug 24.4-26.0, then the end card.

shots.name: poster
shots.prompt: Static camera, no zoom, no cuts. A stylized 3D animated photographer stands as a silhouette on a high rocky ridge above a sea of pink and peach clouds at first light, camera raised; the mist drifts slowly in the valley and the gold rim of light on her edge brightens. Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, same van, nothing morphs or drifts. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: diorama
shots.prompt: Locked-off tripod camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts. A tiny isometric diorama of a granite ledge with a pine and a small teal camper van sits on a pale lavender studio backdrop in cool pre-dawn light. The diorama is a still miniature model: the van is parked with the handbrake on and never moves, rocks or sways, the slab and the pine are fixed in place like a photograph. Only the light is alive: the van's windows glow warm and flicker softly, tiny star specks twinkle above the slab, a wisp of mist curls at the slab's edge. Clean pale backdrop throughout. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: m_dawn
shots.prompt: Continuous single take, locked-off tripod camera, no camera movement. On the tiny still diorama on a pale lavender backdrop, dawn arrives: warm pink and gold light spreads across the slab from the left, the pine tip and van roof catch the gold, and soft white mist pours over the slab's front edge like a tiny waterfall of cloud while the star specks fade. The van is parked and completely motionless, it never rocks, sways or slides; the slab and the pine are fixed in place. Only the light and the mist change. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, same van, nothing morphs or drifts. shots.name: falls
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. In a mossy fern gorge at midday golden sunbeams fan through the waterfall's spray and a small rainbow shimmers; on the wet rocks the man in the red rain jacket and the woman in the yellow rain jacket stand side by side with both feet planted on the rock, arms around each other's waists, and burst out laughing as the spray splashes over them, each with exactly two legs, while the photographer on the left keeps her camera up and fires, then laughs with them; water droplets sparkle. Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, nothing morphs or drifts. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: sky
shots.prompt: Very slow tilt down from the sky, no cuts. The Milky Way arches over a still mountain lake at night, stars twinkle, a shooting star crosses the sky, the reflection in the black water ripples gently and the tiny warm camp lights on the far shore flicker. No people. Crisp, vivid colours, no haze.

Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, same van, nothing morphs or drifts.
